description: FTL-specific script: Firebase Test Lab Pixels ship with NO lock screen / NO biometrics enrolled, so isDeviceSecure() is false and createVault fails closed with DEVICE_NOT_SECURE. Onboarding cannot reach the telemetry-consent screen or the main wallet — the happy-path assertions from android-pin-onboarding-robo-script.json would always fail here for a reason the app is DESIGNED to fail on. This variant asserts the ACTUAL correct behaviour on wide-open devices: PR #2484's actionable copy renders instead of the old generic fail-closed banner. See CLAUDE.md 'DEVICE_NOT_SECURE' notes.
Explicitly submit the eight-digit PIN via the stable visible button text
Explicitly submit PIN confirmation via the stable visible button text
Allow the provisioning path to run and DEVICE_NOT_SECURE to surface. Argon2id KDF plus the biometric-probe cache read on FTL Pixels usually resolves inside ~10s; leave 30s of slack.

The Play-rejection generic fail-closed banner must remain absent — this is the same tripwire the happy-path script carries. The DEVICE_NOT_SECURE path now shows a specific actionable message, not this string. If this assertion ever fires again, PR #2484's branch has regressed.

elementDescriptors.text: Wallet setup couldn't finish securely, so nothing was saved. Please set your PIN and try again.

description: The DEVICE_NOT_SECURE actionable copy from PR #2484 must be visible. This is the positive assertion that proves the fix rendered on real hardware.

elementDescriptors.text: Please set a device passcode or biometric before creating a wallet.
